method.pair_key: root id before |foe=, fixed foe, candidate_owner
method.action_identity: kind, actor_type_id, base_type_id, from_square, to_square, promotion_target_id; compiler-local geometry/pattern IDs omitted

interpretation: Changed first actions co-occur with a larger positive finite reward contrast than unchanged first actions in this saved sample. The action category is post hoc and later play remains part of the reward, so this is an association, not an action-level causal effect. It does not resolve the unit-foe/owner-1 UNKNOWN interval or alter the existing static_v2 retention decision.
